entrypoint.do: if (($env.BAYT_LOCAL_MOCK_AI? | default '1') == '0') { if (which ollama | is-empty) { error make { msg: 'ollama not found on PATH' } }; with-env { OLLAMA_HOST: $'127.0.0.1:($env.PORT? | default "11434")' } { ^ollama serve } } else { let f = (($env.BAYT_LOCAL_WORK_DIR? | default $nu.temp-dir) | path join 'ollama-mock.ts'); open --raw .bayt/Dockerfile.smollm3 | lines | skip until {|l| $l =~ '^COPY <<.EOF. /srv/ollama.ts$' } | skip 1 | take until {|l| $l == 'EOF' } | str join (char nl) | save -f $f; with-env { HOST: '127.0.0.1' } { ^deno run --allow-net --allow-env $f } }
